# Directed operations against exact arithmetic: op a b result side edge, where edge is the
# binary64 number next to the exact result on the side the result must lie (ge: result >= edge).
op add_up 3ff0000000000000 3ca0000000000000 3ff0000000000001 ge 3ff0000000000001 # tie to even below the exact sum
op add_up 3ff0000000000000 3c90000000000000 3ff0000000000001 ge 3ff0000000000001 # below half an ulp
op add_up 3fd5555555555555 3fe5555555555555 3ff0000000000001 ge 3ff0000000000000 # two roundings
op add_up 0000000000000001 0000000000000001 0000000000000003 ge 0000000000000002 # subnormal, exact
op add_up 7fefffffffffffff 7fefffffffffffff 7ff0000000000000 ge 7ff0000000000000 # overflow
op mul_up 0000000000000001 3fe0000000000000 0000000000000001 ge 0000000000000001 # RN(h/2) = 0 < h/2
op mul_up 4008000000000000 3fd5555555555555 3ff0000000000001 ge 3ff0000000000000 # RN(3 RN(1/3)) = 1 above the exact product
op mul_up 3ff0000000000001 3ff0000000000001 3ff0000000000003 ge 3ff0000000000003 # adjacent floats
op mul_up 1a70000000000000 1a70000000000000 0000000000000001 ge 0000000000000001 # product underflows to zero
op mul_up 7fefffffffffffff 4000000000000000 7ff0000000000000 ge 7ff0000000000000 # overflow
op div_up 3ff0000000000000 4008000000000000 3fd5555555555556 ge 3fd5555555555556 # RN(1/3) < 1/3
op div_up 0000000000000001 4000000000000000 0000000000000001 ge 0000000000000001 # subnormal quotient rounds to zero
op div_up 4000000000000000 4008000000000000 3fe5555555555556 ge 3fe5555555555556 # RN(2/3) > 2/3
op sub_dn 3ff0000000000000 3fefffffffffffff 3c9fffffffffffff le 3ca0000000000000 # cancellation, exact
op sub_dn 3ff0000000000000 3c90000000000000 3fefffffffffffff le 3fefffffffffffff # below half an ulp
op sub_dn 3ff0000000000000 3fd5555555555555 3fe5555555555555 le 3fe5555555555555 # RN(1 - RN(1/3))
op sub_dn 0000000000000002 0000000000000001 0000000000000000 le 0000000000000001 # subnormal, exact
op sub_dn 3fe0000000000000 3fe0000000000000 8000000000000001 le 8000000000000000 # exact zero
erased 0000000000000001 l21 0000000000000000 d2 4000000000000000 residual 0000000000000001 relative 0000000000000000 allowance 0000000000000004
